newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian T-bill issue heavily undersubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romanian T-bill issue heavily undersubscribed.

text.p: An issue of 1.155 trillion lei ($166.2 million) of Romanian Finance Ministry floating-rate treasury bills was heavily undersubscribed, the central bank said on Friday.
With a leu-hungry money market, six banks, along with their corporate clients, bought only 115.75 billion lei of the total bills offered at Thursday's public subscription.
The Finance Ministry papers mature on May 15 and offer an annual yield calculated at the average of the weekly auctioned credit rates during their life period.
The average one-week rate soared to 125.54 percent at Thursday's refinancing auction from 90 percent last week.
-- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 ($ = 6950 Romanian Lei)
